mapper.sql: id, exe_id, completeness_id, continuous_id, effect_id, risk_id, total_points, comments, evaluator, evaluated_at
mapper.select:
select eva.id AS eva_id, eva.exe_id AS eva_exe_id, eva.completeness_id AS eva_completeness_id, eva.continuous_id AS eva_continuous_id, eva.effect_id AS eva_effect_id, eva.risk_id AS eva_risk_id, eva.total_points AS eva_total_points, eva.comments AS eva_comments, eva.evaluator AS eva_evaluator, eva.evaluated_at AS eva_evaluated_at, tcompleteness.completeness_id as tcompleteness_completeness_id, tcompleteness.goal_setting_points as tcompleteness_goal_setting_points, tcompleteness.risk_identification_points as tcompleteness_risk_identification_points, tcompleteness.coping_measures_points as tcompleteness_coping_measures_points, tcompleteness.resource_allocation_points as tcompleteness_resource_allocation_points, tcompleteness.responsibility_division_points as tcompleteness_responsibility_division_points, tcompleteness.total_points as tcompleteness_total_points, tcontinuous.continuous_id as tcontinuous_continuous_id, tcontinuous.time_continuity_points as tcontinuous_time_continuity_points, tcontinuous.spatial_continuity_points as tcontinuous_spatial_continuity_points, tcontinuous.total_points as tcontinuous_total_points, teffect.effect_id as teffect_effect_id, teffect.disaster_loss_control_points_points as teffect_disaster_loss_control_points_points, teffect.emergency_response_speed_points as teffect_emergency_response_speed_points, teffect.emergency_response_efficiency_points as teffect_emergency_response_efficiency_points, teffect.public_satisfaction_points as teffect_public_satisfaction_points, teffect.total_points as teffect_total_points, trisk.risk_id as trisk_risk_id, trisk.resource_shortage_points as trisk_resource_shortage_points, trisk.personnel_injury_points as trisk_personnel_injury_points, trisk.facility_damage_points as trisk_facility_damage_points, trisk.public_panic_points as trisk_public_panic_points, trisk.total_points as trisk_total_points from t_plan_eva eva left join t_plan_eva_completeness tcompleteness on eva.completeness_id = tcompleteness.completeness_id left join t_plan_eva_continuous tcontinuous on tcontinuous.continuous_id = eva.continuous_id left join t_plan_eva_effect teffect on teffect.effect_id = eva.effect_id left join t_plan_eva_risk trisk on trisk.risk_id = eva.risk_id
and eva.exe_id = #{executionId}
